critical_findings.primary_issue: Biased AI prompt templates causing inflated confidence scores

root_cause_location.issue: Hardcoded 0.9 confidence values in example JSON

validation_gaps: No validation layer between AI response and user
No requirement for AI to justify confidence scores
No distinction between user-provided and AI-generated data

immediate_fix_required.action: Replace hardcoded 0.9 values with variable placeholders

short_term: Remove biased confidence values from prompt examples
Add validation layer for AI responses
Require justification for all confidence scores
long_term: Build user context system for capability assessment
Implement interactive verification for AI suggestions
Add transparency indicators for AI-generated content
